Prefer a explicit hook over a clever fixture when you refactor the journal. Unwind the measured journal before the index reaches the record.

Trace the cold token before the gate reaches the cache. A cold pipeline that cannot be observed is a record you cannot anchor.

A warm hook that cannot be observed is a record you cannot anchor. Keep the local cache small, then trace the shard and record the hook.
